update.foreach: UPDATE idevelop_device_storage_list SET ci_entity_id = #{value}, is_to_cmdb = 1 WHERE uuid = #{key} AND is_deleted = 0

mapper.select: SELECT t_storage.region_code AS area, t_storage.dept_code AS dept, t_storage.wbs_project AS wbsElementName, t_storage.receiver AS entryWarehousePerson, DATE_FORMAT( t_storage.storage_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS inWarehouseDate, t_storage.owner_unit AS ownerUnitCode, t_storage.property_dept AS propertyDeptCode, t_storage_list.erp_asset_code AS assetCodeErp, t_storage_list.erp_account_code AS deviceCodeErp, t_storage_list.remark AS remark, t_storage.*, t_storage_list.*, wh.uuid AS inWarehouseCode, wh.warehouse_name AS inWarehouse, wh.address AS warehouseLocation, dr.device_add_type AS deviceAddType, dr.device_change_type AS soType, dr.use_keep_dept AS useKeepDept, dr.use_keep_dept_name AS useKeepDeptName, dr.entity_keep_dept AS realManageDept, dr.entity_keep_dept_name AS entityManagementDeptName, dr.fun_location AS funLocation, dr.fun_location_code AS funLocationCode, dr.factory_area AS factoryArea, dr.factory_area_code AS factoryAreaCode, dr.maintenance_factory AS maintenanceFactory, dr.maintenance_factory_code AS maintenanceFactoryCode, dr.maintenance_country AS maintenanceCountry, dr.line_station AS lineStation, dr.line_station AS lineStationSign, dr.unit AS measureUnit FROM idevelop_device_storage_list t_storage_list LEFT JOIN idevelop_device_storage t_storage ON t_storage.id = t_storage_list.storage_id AND t_storage.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN idevelop_warehouse wh ON t_storage.warehouse = wh.uuid AND wh.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN idevelop_device_record_list drl ON drl.erp_asset_code = t_storage_list.erp_asset_code AND drl.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN idevelop_device_record dr ON dr.id = drl.record_id AND dr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t_storage_list.is_deleted = 0 AND t_storage.id = #{id}

SELECT dr.manufacturer AS maker, dr.oprt_date AS oprtDate, dr.unit AS unit, dr.nameplate_no AS nameplateNo FROM idevelop_device_record_list drl LEFT JOIN idevelop_device_record dr ON dr.id = drl.record_id WHERE drl.is_deleted = 0 AND dr.is_deleted = 0 AND drl.device_uuid = #{uuid}
